name: The Long Way Round
hint: Five takes. Walker w1 owns the whole middle of the floor from x=12 to x=26, and the door at x=30 needs three plates held at once — all three sitting inside that middle. The teleporter is how you get past it: step into pad A at x=4 and you are emitted from pad B at x=20, on the far side of the guard. Only YOU teleport; an Echo never does, which does not matter because an Echo cannot be killed. TAKE 1: walk to the step at x=9..11.2 (a 1.8 rise, and still left of the walker's span) and up onto the perch at x=11.8 (a 2.4 rise). Stand. w1 gathers below at its left bound near x=12 and cannot reach you. TAKE 2: Echo A has w1 pinned at the far left of its span for good. Walk into pad A at x=4, arrive at pad B at x=20, then walk to p1 at x=16..18 and stand — it is 4 units from the pinned walker but the walker is locked onto the Echo it noticed first and will not switch. TAKE 3: same route, stand on p2 at x=21. TAKE 4: same route, stand on p3 at x=24.5. TAKE 5: all four Echoes are holding — the guard is watching the perch and the three plates are down, so the door at x=30 is open by about t=2s. Teleport, walk right through the doorway, and into the exit at x=35.

dialogue.text: The pads only move living weight. Your recordings walk.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: They do not mind the long way. They cannot be hurt on it.
